g.text: Manuscript Fig. 4 plume convention: observed black line; coral El Niño forecasts from February–June.
Monthly leads 1–9; no future PMM observations. Each row shares its y-axis across both models and all fitting protocols.
T and h are shown in their protocol-specific detrended anomaly coordinates. PMM denotes the standard MCA SST coefficient.
